directions_considered.name: P1-A · DAWN TABLETS (sermon-tablet grammar)
directions_considered.palette: Binding Solar Gospel tokens; solar lead, serpent secondary, bone text on lapis/night.
directions_considered.signature: The Dawn-Ring seal + verbatim pull-line + sun-rule opener; 6 text-central artworks (1 scene, 1 triptych, 3 emblems, 1 finale) rise above 17 quiet tablets.
directions_considered.summary: Conform to the adopted book identity: every P1 opener is seal/scene/emblem art, then Cinzel part line, Cinzel title, ONE verbatim pull-line, sun-rule. Sermon-dominant Part I (17 tablets) stays calm; the chapters whose prose stages a visual event earn authored art. Voice varies by content (satire, parable, aphorism, dialogue, threshold, dusk), never by position.
directions_considered.type: Cinzel display / Newsreader body (pending collision ruling; stack swappable) / DM Sans chrome.

directions_considered.name: P1-B · HORIZON SCROLL (sun climbs 1→23)
directions_considered.rejected_why: Mechanical position-encoding (sun altitude = chapter index) is mod-N logic in a prettier coat; it forces near-identical adjacent openers (same horizon band, sun nudged) which the binding rules forbid; and sky-bands invite gradients-as-art. The dawn-to-noontide arc is real but must be carried by pull-line voices and content, not a sun-position gimmick.
directions_considered.signature: One continuous dawn horizon band; the sun climbs a little every chapter from p1c1 to p1c23.
directions_considered.summary: A single horizon frieze shared by all P1 openers, sun altitude encoding chapter order.

directions_considered.name: P1-C · BESTIARY MARGINALIA (a creature per chapter)
directions_considered.rejected_why: Overloads sermons: most P1 animals are passing metaphors (dogs, birds, scorpion, flies, sponge), not subjects — literalizing all of them flattens hierarchy, starves the 6 true visual events of emphasis, doubles the art load, and steals Part IV's parade-emblem thunder. Metaphors stay in prose and pull-lines; only text-central beasts are drawn.
directions_considered.signature: Every chapter gets a marginal creature emblem in opener + TOC.
directions_considered.summary: Illustrate every animal named anywhere in Part I (~15 emblems).

entries.rationale: The book's overture (150 paras, 4766 words): dawn sun-address (§1–10), forest saint + 'God is dead' (§11–28), marketplace Superman/Ultimate-Man sermons (§29–100), tightrope walker and buffoon (§106–107), corpse carried and buried in a hollow tree (§108–126, §137), companions-not-corpses resolve + rainbow (§127–142), eagle and serpent at noon (§143–150). Lead summary verified; beats the lead omitted (saint, Ultimate Man, hollow-tree burial) are staged in the scene's third beat and sky. The rope line is both the chapter's thesis and the inherited Direction-B motif.
entries.reading_treatment: Epic measure 40rem, gap 1.2em, calm throughout; no mid-text decoration per Rule 2. The 'I love him who…' anaphora (§59–74) and Ultimate-Man sequence (§88–100) carry their own rhythm; the closing cresting-sun mini-seal (App. A.0) lands after 'Thus began Zarathustra's down-going.'
entries.subject: Zarathustra descends at dawn, addresses the sun, meets the God-unaware saint, preaches Superman and the Ultimate Man to a laughing market square, witnesses the rope-walker's fall, buries him, resolves to seek companions, and is found at noon by his eagle and serpent.
entries.title: Zarathustra's Prologue
entries.voice: vision-epic: prophetic address layered over marketplace noise and night burial.

pull_line_method: ONE verbatim pull-line per chapter from the chapter's own JSON paragraphs, cited as §N (para N). Excerpts are whole sentences (or whole speeches with outer dialogue quotes trimmed — noted per entry). No invented epigraphs. Full-sentence trims (trailing clauses kept or whole-sentence selections) are each noted in the cite field. Z4: every pull-line verbatim + §-cited; verified against chapter JSON in this spec.
references: Henry van de Velde, deluxe Also sprach Zarathustra, Insel Verlag 1908 (Yale Art Gallery 1997.56.3; NGA 163764; Fonts In Use via Getty/Archive.org scan) — authored line + monumental title; ornament linear and architectural. Collection-record study.

William Blake, illuminated prophetic books esp. Jerusalem (V&A O901355; YCBA; Tate; 'infernal method' scholarship) — emblems fused with the text block; prophetic utterance with inscriptional weight. Record/scholarship study.

Shir-o-Khorshid Lion-and-Sun emblem of Persia (Wikipedia 'Lion and Sun'; BMITP continuity paper; WorldHistory.org Zoroaster) — historical root of the solar grammar; staff-head legitimacy. Record study.

Caspar David Friedrich, Wanderer above the Sea of Fog (Met 378) and Morning in the Riesengebirge (WGA; Nationalgalerie) — Rückenfigur before dawn ridges; Part I as 'first light over an abyss'. Record study.

Michael Maier, Atalanta Fugiens (1618, De Bry engravings; Frankfurt UB digitization; Hermetic School emblem archive) — circular pictura + motto structure as ancestor of the seal + pull-line opener; sun/serpent/eagle iconography. Record study.
Ferdinand Hodler, Parallelism (Rijksmuseum; Kunstmuseum Bern; National Galleries Scotland) — symmetric dawn-ridge friezes; informed the p1c1 3-beat scene rhythm. Record study.

tokens_binding.body: Spectral 400/1.9 (400/500 + true italics; Spectral SC 500/600 available for speech labels) — DIRECTOR RULING 2026-10-15: Newsreader OUT (Churchill + WtP hold it; Zarathustra needs a distinct lyric italic). Metrics redesigned around Spectral. Fallback: Georgia, serif.
tokens_binding.display: Cinzel 400–700 (Google Fonts, verified live) — cover title, chapter titles (book title-case, NEVER forced uppercase), part lines, seal legends, TOC part headers. Fallback: 'Trajan Pro', Georgia, serif.
tokens_binding.measure: Prose 36–40rem per entry (intimate 36 / standard 38 / epic+finale 40); titles free; pull-lines max 44rem centered within tablet.
tokens_binding.note: Binding per adopted Direction A + ArtDirector verdict (Z1–Z4, Z7). Derived tints ONLY via color-mix; no new hues. Z1 GOLD FIREWALL: all gold is FLAT engraved SVG line-work — zero radial/conic glow discs, zero text-shadow halos on Cinzel; luminous = REVISE. Z2: Cinzel LITURGICAL (inscriptions, seals, pull-lines), never bronze-tablet minimalism (Twilight's). Pull-line text stays BONE; only the § cite is gold.
tokens_binding.scale: Chapter title Cinzel 600 clamp(2rem,5vw,3.25rem) balanced ≤3 lines (verified at 390px: wraps to 2 lines, no overflow); part line Cinzel 400 0.85rem tracked 0.3em sentence case ('Part the First · I'; 0.72rem/0.22em ≤640px); pull-line Spectral italic 1.15rem/1.7 bone (1.02rem ≤640px); body Spectral 400 1.3rem/1.9 (1.12rem/1.8 ≤640px); sun-rule 11–14rem per entry (9–10rem ≤640px).
